references.text: Continuation of the punishment for one who sins with a raised hand—the person has despised the Lord's word and broken his command.
The one who acts presumptuously and will not listen to the priest or the judge shall die—the same principle regarding deliberate rebellion against God.
Whoever eats leavened bread shall be cut off from Israel—the same punishment as being severed from the people.
Whoever profanes the Sabbath shall be cut off from their people—a parallel to the penalty for intentional sin.
The one who blasphemes God's name shall die—a direct parallel to blaspheming (מְגַדֵּף) the Lord.
A prayer to be kept from presumptuous sins—referring to sin committed with a raised hand.
If we sin willfully after receiving knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins—a New Testament parallel to intentional sin without forgiveness.
Whoever blasphemes the Holy Spirit will never receive forgiveness—a parallel to blaspheming the Lord with no possibility of atonement.
